comment: The solar wind speed is currently at background levels, and geomagnetic activity has been QUIET. We do not anticipate any significant enhancement in solar wind speed during the first forecast period, and geomagnetic activity is expected to remain QUIET. A CME produced by an M-class solar flare yesterday afternoon (UT) is expected to arrive at Earth during the second forecast period. Upon arrival, geomagnetic activity is expected to increase to ACTIVE levels on average, with isolated STORM G1 intervals possible. Conditions are expected to gradually subside throughout the third forecast period.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
